Hi Samira,

Thanks again for the time this morning — great to learn more about AtlasHealth's latency and data residency needs. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Cloud: AWS (us-west-2), want either VPC peering or PrivateLink option; interested in SOC2 evidence.

Next step: technical architecture review (60 min) so our solutions engineer can walk your infra team through the VPC options, networking, and integration checklist. Could you confirm who from AtlasHealth should be on the call (network/security/CTO)?
